description: T-ENGINE-004 ordinary-client release gate for two complete offline Combat Simulator cycles. It starts through the direct debug launch, fires the real CMP150 path at a nearby bot, marks a controlled non-tied kill matrix ready in live gameplay, commits it immediately before production award calculation, returns through Play Again with user-owned options intact, auto-starts from the real Room boundary, and repeats through a second endscreen. V-009 visual fidelity remains owned by the dedicated gameplay-capture gate rather than this lifecycle smoke.

input_sequence.comment: Boot, seed one human plus first bot slot 8, and start through the direct match boundary.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_SKIP_CUTSCENE
input_sequence.comment: Repeated canonical hold-to-skip windows cover warm and cold stage-load timing; entering a later cutscene flushes an early hold.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_PRIMARY
input_sequence.comment: Exercise the ordinary first-person CMP150 shot path only after the 15-second root-stability hold has completed and released gameplay ownership of the bot.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_USE
input_sequence.comment: Activate the real Play Again action-bar widget shortly after first endscreen entry.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_SKIP_CUTSCENE
input_sequence.comment: Skip the second-cycle fly-in after the Room-originated start.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_USE
input_sequence.comment: Cold-load fallback; after a successful return this is harmless gameplay/cutscene input, while a late endscreen still receives the canonical accept edge.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_PRIMARY
input_sequence.comment: Exercise gameplay again after the Room-originated second start.
Bounded release-gate exit after both complete Combat Simulator cycles.
